description: NOTE: This event starts at 5PM Central/6PM Eastern. Spooktacular time is here! Join Team AMG for this FREE event at the Adderley Amphitheater at Cascades Park for trick-or-treating, costumes, games, food, and a ghoulishly good concert! Trick-or-treating starts at 6pm, music starts at 7:30pm.
